The '''Hurikane system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hurikane]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Unidentified Hurikane species|species]] of rock-like insectoids.
